decisions.decision: eww popup uses :focusable false + a scrim backdrop + button->eventbox, NOT :unfocus-close/:onkeypressed
decisions.rationale: Hyprland 0.55.4 does not give an eww overlay layer keyboard focus on open, so focus-dependent close never fires; GTK buttons need a focus-grab that fails on the layer surface, while eventboxes fire on raw pointer; a fully-transparent backdrop is treated as click-through so it needs a faint scrim.

decisions.decision: swaync config.json changes (toggle label) require `swaync-client --reload-config` / restart, not just `swaync-client -rs` (which is CSS-only)
decisions.rationale: The theme glyph looked 'still missing' after -rs because the label lives in config.json.

decisions.decision: swaync blur = translucent .control-center + widgets (alpha) so the pre-existing `blur, swaync-control-center` layerrule has something to frost; the rule + namespace were already correct
decisions.rationale: The layer was opaque so blur had no effect; the fix is translucency, not the rule.
